description:
Get recent crypto news for a coin or topic: up to 10 articles from the past hour, day or week with publisher, date, snippet and link, plus a short AI read of the coverage (mood: positive, negative, mixed or neutral; a summary; main themes) written only from those headlines. A read of the news, not advice.

$0.004 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

When to use: You want what's being said about a coin or the market right now.
Use instead: web_search with type "news" for non-crypto topics; crypto_market_pulse for numbers instead of headlines.
Parameters: query: a coin or topic; leave it out for the whole market. freshness: hour, day (default) or week. num: 1-10 articles, default 8.
Returns: articles[] with title, publisher, date, snippet and link, plus mood (positive, negative, mixed or neutral), a summary and themes, written only from those headlines.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

query.description: Coin or topic, e.g. "solana" or "bitcoin ETF". Leave out for the whole crypto market.

name: crypto_news
title: Crypto news
